faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need to sign up before buying a course?
faq.a1: Yes. You need a free account before you can purchase a course and start learning.
faq.q2: Can I take the lessons out of order?
faq.a2: No. Each topic unlocks only after you complete the previous topic and pass its quiz — this ensures deep, systematic learning.
faq.q3: What's the difference between a subscription and buying a single course?
faq.a3: A single course gives access to just that one track. A subscription gives access to every course at once, and is far more cost-effective long-term.
faq.a4: You can pay online via Click or Payme. The course unlocks immediately once payment is confirmed.
faq.q5: Where do I watch the video lessons?
faq.a5: All video lessons play directly on our site through the built-in player.
